boundary: Current evidence is proxy-grade, not asset-class ROIC.

deeper_question: Does Sterling backlog convert into cash-returning work or only expand reported RPO?
current_evidence: RPO grew from 2.055081B USD to 4.233618B USD; OCF less capex was positive across observed quarters; July 2026 credit wrapper has 1.500B USD revolver and 600M USD L/C sublimit.
upgrade_evidence_needed: Project-level margin, backlog burn, cancellation, retainage collection, actual L/C/surety usage, and owner-funding evidence.
decision_use: Decide whether Sterling is a high-quality conversion platform or a backlog aggregator with hidden execution risk.
boundary: Current evidence is company-level conversion proxy, not project-level return proof.

deeper_question: Do entity debt and growth capex convert into train-level cash returns?

decision_use: Decide whether LNG buildout is project-and-cash-grade or still only entity/output-grade.
boundary: Entity and cargo proof do not prove train-level return.

deeper_question: Do named NGL/export capacity additions create measurable utilization, EBITDA, and DCF contribution?
current_evidence: Company-level EBITDA, DCF, growth capex, credit facility, note refinancing, and named capacity additions are visible.

deeper_question: Does utility demand and storm-hardening spend become approved, recoverable, in-service rate-base or clause investment?
current_evidence: FPL Distribution Inspection links 193199 projects, 61.5M USD AP-1 actual cost, 15.942971M USD final recovery, 10.481240M USD equity component, 2.278910M USD debt component, 3.182821M USD depreciation, 804.620369M USD aggregate SPPCRC clause revenue, and Form 8A capital-structure support; Transmission Inspection links 84056 projects, 66.3M USD actual cost, and 23.595154M USD final recovery; AEP/Duke have tariff mechanics, customer-obligation process, generation-resource path, Anderson County approval, and resource-plan evidence.
upgrade_evidence_needed: SPPCRC category customer receipts, financing source allocation, docket status, approved capital, customer contribution, recovery rider/rate-base treatment, in-service date, and who-pays-first map.
decision_use: Separate investable utility capex from speculative load or recovery commentary.
boundary: Load forecasts and aggregate clause revenue are not category cash receipts or project funding proof.

deeper_question: Do borrower loans create durable enterprise value or only enable acquisition/refinancing leverage?

boundary: Holder rows are destination proof, not borrower return proof.

deeper_question: Does private-credit takeout improve or weaken borrower financing resilience?
current_evidence: Auctane confirms selected takeout; Medallia has strong repayment evidence; Atwell remains unresolved; banks may remain in ancillary roles.
